name: ACADEMY34
source:
In ACADEMY34 you are taking on a role of a freshman cadet, who had just enrolled into the prestigious Sentinel Academy, a place, where young people train to become Agents, dedicating their lives to protecting the world from the terror and, basically, just bad things in general. In reality, no matter how pompous this place is trying to appear, it is still a yet another rich school, filled with hundreds of young adults trying to figure out their place in life. The moment you make your first step on the grounds of this Academy, you realized that maybe you are not ready to become an agent just yet. The idea of dedicating your life sounded so heroic, but now there's a strange lingering thought inside your mind — you want to experience the absurd and chaotic student life. You really do. Though, not like it depends on your choice, as misadventures have already begun!

[From [url=https://young-and-naughty.itch.io/academy34]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《ACADEMY34》中，你将扮演一名新生学员的角色，他刚刚入读著名的哨兵学院，在这里，年轻人接受训练成为特工，奉献自己的一生来保护世界免受恐怖袭击，基本上只是一般的坏事。事实上，无论这个地方试图显得多么浮夸，它仍然是另一所富裕的学校，里面挤满了数百名试图找到自己人生定位的年轻人。当你踏入这所学院的第一步时，你意识到也许你还没有准备好成为一名特工。奉献一生的想法听起来很豪迈，但现在你的脑海里却有一个奇怪的念头——你想体验一下荒唐而混乱的学生生活。你确实这么做了。不过，这并不取决于你的选择，因为不幸的冒险已经开始了！

[来自[url=https://young-and-naughty.itch.io/academy34]itch.io[/url]]
